name: Regina Barzilay
researchFocus: Develops machine learning methods for drug discovery and clinical AI, including deep learning models for oncology and chemistry; previously worked on natural language processing.
title: School of Engineering Distinguished Professor of AI and Health

name: Antonio Torralba
researchFocus: Researches computer vision, machine learning and human visual perception, building systems that can perceive the world like humans do.
title: Delta Electronics Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

name: Fei-Fei Li
researchFocus: AI researcher focusing on deep learning, robotic learning, spatial intelligence and ambient intelligence for healthcare delivery; inventor of ImageNet.
title: Sequoia Professor of Computer Science

name: Percy Liang
researchFocus: Director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models; works on making foundation models (especially language models) more accessible through open-source and understandable through rigorous benchmarking, including robustness, interpretability and reasoning.
title: Associate Professor of Computer Science

name: Pieter Abbeel
researchFocus: Director of the Berkeley Robot Learning Lab and Co-Director of the Berkeley AI Research (BAIR) Lab; research in artificial intelligence, deep reinforcement learning and robotics.
title: Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences

name: Joseph Gonzalez
researchFocus: Works at the intersection of machine learning and computer systems, studying next-generation cloud and AI systems for high-performance machine learning, including LLM inference and serving, distributed systems for large-scale ML and AI agents.
title: Associate Professor of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences

name: Michael Bronstein
researchFocus: Geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, 3D shape analysis, protein design and non-human species communication.
title: DeepMind Professor of Artificial Intelligence

name: Sadie Creese
researchFocus: Teaches and researches operational aspects of cybersecurity including threat detection, risk assessment and security architectures, with work on cyber risk, threat modelling and national cybersecurity capacity.
title: Professor of Cybersecurity

name: Neil Lawrence
researchFocus: Works on machine learning models and the interaction of machine learning with the physical world, advancing scientific discovery with machine learning.
title: DeepMind Professor of Machine Learning

name: Andreas Vlachos
researchFocus: Current projects include dialogue modelling, automated fact-checking and imitation learning; also worked on semantic parsing, natural language generation, summarisation, language modelling and information extraction.
title: Professor of Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning

name: Tom Mitchell
researchFocus: Research in machine learning, artificial intelligence and cognitive neuroscience, focused on how to construct computers that learn from experience, including machine learning approaches to analysing human brain activity.
title: Founders University Professor of Machine Learning

name: Christos Faloutsos
researchFocus: Large-scale data mining with emphasis on graphs and time sequences, anomaly and fraud detection in graphs and time series, tensors and fractals.
title: Fredkin Professor of Computer Science

name: Raquel Urtasun
researchFocus: Research spans machine learning, computer vision and robotics, with a focus on generative AI for the physical world and the next generation of self-driving technology.
title: Professor of Computer Science

name: Eyal de Lara
researchFocus: Research lies in cloud and mobile computing, with novel algorithms for system virtualization, edge computing, application scaling, indoor localization, mobile security and continuous mobile sensing.
title: Professor of Computer Science

name: Min-Yen Kan
researchFocus: Research interests span digital libraries, natural language processing and information retrieval, including scholarly digital libraries, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and recommendation systems.
title: Associate Professor of Computer Science

name: Mohan Kankanhalli
researchFocus: Research interests are in multimodal computing, computer vision and trustworthy AI, including image and video understanding, visual saliency, content authentication and privacy.
title: Provost's Chair Professor of Computer Science
